cards.ex: After his DUI, he decided to go to rehab to deal with his alcohol problem.
cards.exUz: Haydovchilik paytida mast holda qo'lga tushganidan so'ng, u alkogol muammosini hal qilish uchun reabilitatsiyaga borishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikdan davolanish uchun reabilitatsiya markaziga murojaat qilish.

cards.ex: He was spending all his money feeding his gambling habit.
cards.exUz: U butun pulini qimor o'ynash odatini boqishga sarflayotgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikni davom ettirish, qaram bo'lgan narsaga pul sarflash.

cards.ex: I felt like I was a slave to my phone; I couldn't put it down.
cards.exUz: O'zimni telefonimning quli deb his qilardim; uni qo'yolmasdim.
cards.uzDef: Nimagadir to'liq qaram bo'lib, uni boshqara olmaslik.

cards.ex: He's been on the mend since he started attending AA meetings.
cards.exUz: U AA yig'ilishlariga qatnashishni boshlaganidan beri tuzalmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sog'lig'ini tiklamoqda, yaxshilanmoqda (qaramlikdan keyin).

cards.ex: I hit a wall in my recovery; I just wanted to give up.
cards.exUz: Sog'ayishimda devorga urildim; shunchaki taslim bo'lishni xohladim.
cards.uzDef: Davolanish jarayonida qiyinchilikka duch kelish, to'xtab qolish.

cards.ex: Social media is a quick fix for boredom, but it's not really fulfilling.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy media zerikish uchun tez yechim, lekin u haqiqatan ham qoniqarli emas.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni vaqtincha hal qiladigan, lekin uzoq muddatli yechim bo'lmagan narsa.

cards.ex: After losing his job, he went into a downward spiral of depression and drinking.
cards.exUz: Ishdan bo'shatilgandan so'ng, u depressiya va ichkilikka berilib, pastga qarab spirallana boshladi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning tobora yomonlashuvi, nazoratni yo'qotish.

cards.ex: His heart attack was a wake-up call to finally quit smoking.
cards.exUz: Uning yurak xuruji chekishni tashlash uchun ogohlantiruvchi qo'ng'iroq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Jiddiy muammo haqida ogohlantiruvchi voqea.

cards.ex: It's hard to stay on track when you're surrounded by temptation.
cards.exUz: Vasvasalar bilan o'ralganingizda, yo'lda qolish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Rejani davom ettirish, tuzalish jarayonida to'g'ri yo'lda bo'lish.

cards.ex: Substance abuse can lead to serious health problems.
cards.exUz: Moddalarni suiiste'mol qilish jiddiy sog'liq muammolariga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Giyohvand moddalar yoki alkogolni me'yoridan ortiq iste'mol qilish.

cards.ex: He was doing so well, but then he fell back on his old habits.
cards.exUz: U juda yaxshi ishlayotgan edi, lekin keyin eski odatlariga qaytdi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi yomon odatlarga qaytish, qaramlikka tushish.

cards.ex: She had to hit bottom before she realized she needed help.
cards.exUz: U yordamga muhtojligini tushunishdan oldin tubiga yetishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Eng yomon holatga tushish, eng past nuqtaga yetish.

cards.ex: Certain songs can be a trigger for my anxiety.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi qo'shiqlar mening xavotirim uchun qo'zg'atuvchi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: O'tmishdagi qaramlikni eslatuvchi va istakni uyg'otuvchi narsa.

cards.ex: It's hard, but you need to stay strong and fight the urge.
cards.exUz: Bu qiyin, lekin siz kuchli bo'lishingiz va istakka qarshi kurashingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, kurashishni davom ettirish, taslim bo'lmaslik.

cards.ex: Rehab gave him a clean slate to start over.
cards.exUz: Reabilitatsiya unga qayta boshlash uchun toza varaq berdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi boshlanish, o'tmishdagi xatolarni unutib, yangi hayot boshlash.

cards.ex: He started to lose control when he started drinking every day.
cards.exUz: U har kuni ichishni boshlaganida nazoratni yo'qota boshladi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatti-harakatlarini boshqara olmaslik, qaramlikka berilish.

cards.ex: It's important to seek treatment if you think you have a problem.
cards.exUz: Agar sizda muammo bor deb o'ylasangiz, davolanishga murojaat qilish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlik muammosini hal qilish uchun tibbiy yordam so'rash.

cards.ex: Exercise is a good coping strategy for dealing with stress.
cards.exUz: Mashq stressni engish uchun yaxshi strategiya.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatlarda o'zini tutish, stressni kamaytirish usuli.

cards.ex: Joining a support group can help you feel less alone.
cards.exUz: Qo'llab-quvvatlash guruhiga qo'shilish o'zingizni yolg'iz his qilmaslikka yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: O'xshash muammolarga ega odamlarning birgalikda yordam berish guruhi.

cards.ex: Self-awareness is key to overcoming addiction.
cards.exUz: O'z-o'zini anglash qaramlikni yengishning kalitidir.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini, odatlarini va harakatlarini tushunish.

cards.ex: It's important to consider the long-term effects of your choices.
cards.exUz: Tanlovingizning uzoq muddatli oqibatlarini ko'rib chiqish muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikning sog'liq, munosabatlar va hayotga uzoq vaqt davom etadigan ta'siri.

cards.ex: Learning craving control is a big part of recovery.
cards.exUz: Istakni boshqarishni o'rganish sog'ayishning katta qismi.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlik tufayli paydo bo'ladigan kuchli istaklarni boshqarish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The road to recovery is long, but it's worth it.
cards.exUz: Sog'ayish yo'li uzoq, lekin bunga arziydi.
cards.uzDef: Qaramlikdan forig' bo'lish uchun qilinadigan harakatlar, jarayon.

cards.ex: Behavioral addiction can be just as destructive as substance abuse.
cards.exUz: Xulqiy qaramlik moddalarni suiiste'mol qilish kabi zararli bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Qimor, o'yinlar yoki internetga qaramlik kabi xulq-atvorga bog'liqlik.

cards.ex: Addiction often goes hand-in-hand with mental health issues.
cards.exUz: Qaramlik ko'pincha ruhiy salomatlik muammolari bilan birga keladi.
cards.uzDef: Insonning hissiy, psixologik va ijtimoiy farovonligi.

cards.ex: Addiction can create a vicious circle of guilt and shame.
cards.exUz: Qaramlik aybdorlik va uyatning yopiq doirasini yaratishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Takrorlanuvchi va yomonlashuvchi muammolar ketma-ketligi.

cards.ex: Building resilience is important for staying sober.
cards.exUz: Chidamli bo'lish hushyor qolish uchun muhim.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarni yengish qobiliyatini rivojlantirish.

cards.ex: Deep breathing is a useful coping skill for anxiety.
cards.exUz: Chuqur nafas olish xavotirlanish uchun foydali yengish mahorati.
cards.uzDef: Stressli vaziyatlarda o'zini boshqarish uchun foydalaniladigan usul.

cards.ex: He finally had to face the music for his addiction and its consequences.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat qaramligi va uning oqibatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z xatolari uchun javobgarlikka tortilish, oqibatlarini qabul qilish.

cards.ex: He's been trying to get clean for years, but it's a constant battle.
cards.exUz: U yillar davomida tozalanishga harakat qilmoqda, lekin bu doimiy kurash.
cards.uzDef: Giyohvand moddalarni iste'mol qilishni to'xtatish va ulardan xalos bo'lish.
